title: Audra McDonald: I Am What I Am
original_title: Audra McDonald: I Am What I Am
overview: With a record-breaking six Tony Awards, alongside two Grammy Awards and an Emmy, Audra McDonald is a powerhouse of musical theatre. Filmed at the iconic London Palladium, bring the electric atmosphere of live theatre to your home. Sing along to musical theatre classics including "I Am What I Am", "Summertime" and "Rose's Turn", performed by one of Broadway's most celebrated stars.
